issue_context.title: Search results shows incorrect matches
issue_context.body:
Attach (recommended) or Link to PDF file here:
[NHA-20211231-A-018_before.pdf](https://github.com/mozilla/pdf.js/files/8055863/NHA-20211231-A-018_before.pdf)

Configuration:
- Web browser and its version: Firefox nightly
- Operating system and its version: Windows 11

Steps to reproduce the problem:
1. Search for "a"
2. Some highlighter results are wrong

![image](https://user-images.githubusercontent.com/5641725/153760070-61708a75-524c-4a21-bc1f-7745e9151b97.png)

After investigations some results are shifted because of a bug with "-\n".

review_comments: It feels slightly confusing that the `p{n}` cases are now appearing out of order, but I'm assuming that it's actually necessary now!?
